title: A 12-mW ADC Delta–Sigma Modulator With 80 dB of Dynamic Range Integrated in a Single-Chip Bluetooth Transceiver
figure_number: Fig. 6. Generalized block diagram of a 17-level DAC.
function_summary: 12-mW ADC Delta–Sigma Modulator: This paper presents a switched-capacitor multibit ADC delta–sigma modulator for baseband demodulation integrated in a single-chip Bluetooth radio-modem transceiver that achieves 77 dB of signal-to-noise-plus-distortion ratio (SINAD) and 80 dB of dynamic range over a 500-kHz bandwidth with a 32-MHz sample rate.
